text.en:
Subject to the terms and conditions established m Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six as amended by Commonwealth,Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of
the Constitution, there is granted to Esperanza Lucerna, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of
this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to.construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and power
plant for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat, and/or power for sale within the limits
of the municipality of Hog, Province of Occidental Negros.

It is expressly provided that in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate
for itself the plant and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee surrender its franchise and will turn over to the
Government all serviceable equipments therein, at cost.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 18, 1939.
